second_method.method: printed BLUE PRINT difficulty table total (Easy 10 + Average 5 + Difficulty 5 = 20), pdf 95; independently, the answer side's keys counted

count_gate.note: Question side labels 1-20 monotonic, no gaps, no duplicates (I 1-5, II 6-10, III 11-15, IV 16-20). Answer side keys 1-20 in order (pdf 127-128). BLUE PRINT 10/5/5 = 20 = audited count. Difficulty per question: easy 0, average 0, difficult 0, untagged 20.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 95 (heading, LO 13, BLUE PRINT, q1-4) 96 (q5-15) 97 (q16-20). A side 'Key Answers Lesson25 My district- Your district' pdf 127 (keys 1-8) 128 (9-20). Folios = pdf page.

ANSWER SIDE (analysed first): keys 1-20 answer q1-q20 by printed number (aligned). Open answers stored as printed (coordinator rev 5): q3, q4 'Own'; q19, q20 'Write in their own districts' (instruction keys, verbatim, unflagged — as the cleared Class-4 instruction key).
BILINGUAL: Kannada dropped; keys 6 and 7 (pdf 127) and key 16 (pdf 128) are followed by legacy-Nudi junk on the same line — cut off (both Kannada greps 0).

Sections: s1 I fill q1-5; s2 II match q6-10 (numbered rows -> one-pair match; keys 6 'Taluk' and 7 'District' flagged against column B 'TalukCenter' / 'District headquarters'); s3 III odd-one-out q11-15 (four unlettered words -> mcq ids A-D by printed order; word keys match by pass 1 except q14 'Potato', which names no option -> null + 'key text not among options' — the options are four towns in the Kannada line, 'Cup' rendering Koppa and the key 'Potato' rendering Alur); s4 IV q16-20.
MARKS (R-E9, rev 3): every header's N equals its printed count -> 1 on all four sections.
MAP: no map question in this lesson (survey and read); no printed map either side.
DIFFICULTY: none printed -> null + 'no difficulty tag'. quota_table difficulty_only; second method = BLUE PRINT total 20 (agrees). LO (R-E10): lesson LO 13, lo_source 'lesson_table'.
FIGURES: none on these pages. TOPIC evs-3-25-t00 / chapter / high (R-E3).
